thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — edge-canary-3 showing sustained 5xx spike (502) across eu-west-1. alert_id=inc-20260317-01. Paging oncall: @elaine
elaine: On it. Looking at grafana, 502s started ~00:07 UTC. Rolling 1m avg error rate 6.8%. Any recent deploys?
pranav: can confirm a canary rollout went live 00:02 UTC — single commit d4f3a2 changed retry/backoff in edge-proxy. Also feature flag "canary-edge-traffic" toggled to 20%.
chris: I'm on traces. Head requests show upstream returning 502s after 1s socket reset. Proxy added a new parallel connect path in d4f3a2.
elaine: Plan: immediate kill-switch for canary flag, then if errors drop, we can rollback or cherry-pick fix. Who can flip feature flag fast?
tara: I can flip via console. Command I use: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/flags/canary-edge-traffic -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'`
elaine: do it. Also enable temporary rate-limit to reduce retry amplification: `rctl update edge-proxy --limit 500r/s`
tara: flipped flag :white_check_mark: flag now false. Observability: error rate down to 2.1% within 30s.
support-bot: Customer impact: 12 customers reported increased errors (tickets: #1221, #1222, #1228). Notified premium customers, attaching temporary workaround.
pranav: good. Now prepare small hotfix: revert the parallel connect change in d4f3a2 -> single-commit revert. I'll open a PR and keep change minimal.
chris: can we avoid a full rollback? If canary off reduces errors, quick patch and small deploy to canary then ramp.
elaine: agree. Pranav, create PR with revert, tag `hotfix/revert-parconnect`. Keep scope narrow (one file).
pranav: PR opened: https://git.redwood/hotfix/revert-parconnect (CI green). prepping canary deploy.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for `hotfix/revert-parconnect` to canary (edge-canary-3). eta ~2m.
elaine: monitoring metrics and traces.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded. health checks OK. :tada:
elaine: error rate to 0.4% and stable for 5m. Looks like kill-switch + revert fixed it.
support-bot: Updated tickets and emailed affected customers with mitigation note + ETA for postmortem. No escalations.
sre-lead: Solid mitigation. We'll schedule a short postmortem tomorrow 09:00 PST. Handing off to next oncall @chris for night coverage.
chris: taking handoff. I'll compile timeline, logs, and the small patch diff.
elaine: added incident to tracker inc-20260317-01, labels: postdeploy, hotfix, feature-flag-kill. Action items: follow-up RCA, testback for parallel connect path.
deploy-bot: Incident marked stable. Auto-close after 30m of healthy metrics. :white_check_mark:
(Incident thread ended)
